translation_snapshot.source: Oddly it never produces a hat.
translation_snapshot.target: 奇怪的是，它没有一顶帽子。

translation_snapshot.source:
Focus your will into a powerful thrust of your telekinetically-wielded weapon to impale your target and then viciously rip it free.
		This deals %d%% weapon damage and then causes the victim to bleed for %0.1f Physical damage over four turns.
		At level 3 the thrust is so powerful that it has %d%% chance to shatter a random temporary magical or psionic damage absorbing shield if one exists.
		The bleeding damage increases with your Mindpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
将你的意志灌入你的念动武器，使它猛力推进并刺穿你的目标并恶毒的绞开它的身体。
		这次攻击将造成 %d%% 武器伤害，并使目标流血 4 回合，累计造成 %0.1f 物理伤害。
		在 3 级时，武器将势不可挡地突进，有 %d%% 几率随机击碎目标身上一个临时的魔法或灵能伤害吸收护盾（如果存在）。
		流血伤害受精神强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source: A vial of grainy, iron-colored fluid.
translation_snapshot.target: 一瓶带有特殊纹理、泛着金属光泽的液体。

translation_snapshot.source: It feels no pain.  It moves with fluidity and strength that would tear natural muscles apart.  It must be from a fresh corpse, since its bones, armor, and weapon are all in pristine condition.  And it's furious.
translation_snapshot.target: 这只骷髅战士没有任何痛感，它的动作行云流水，强大的挥斩足以将常人的肌肉撕裂。它一定是来自一具新鲜的尸体：它的骨头、装甲和武器还是崭新的。并且，他仿佛怒不可遏。

translation_snapshot.source: Their most important stats are: Dexterity and Strength (when using bows) or Cunning (when using slings)
translation_snapshot.target: 他们最重要的属性是：敏捷和力量（装备弓时）或灵巧（装备投石索）

translation_snapshot.source: A trained hound that appears to be all at once a little puppy and a toothless old dog.
translation_snapshot.target: 一条受训的猎犬，它的形态在小狗崽到掉牙的老狗之间来回切换。
